title: Naturality of the normalized hyperplane Kummer map
statement: Let $N>0$ and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. In the ordinary etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use the normalized finite twist transport of [def-amb-p1-trace]. For every scheme $S$ with $N$ invertible, there is a morphism $c_S:A_{P_S}\to A_{P_S}(1)[2]$ whose abelian cohomology realization is the scalar Kummer class of $\mathcal O(1)$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. If $S$ is Noetherian, $c_S$ equals the Chern morphism of the normalized datum [def-amb-p1-trace]. Put $b_S=\operatorname{desc}(\text{twisted unit},\text{adjoint of }c_S)$ [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. For every morphism $f:S^\prime\to S$ between N-invertible schemes, canonical exchange and shifted twist transport take $f^{-1}b_S$ to $b_{S^\prime}$ after the canonical two-summand comparison [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data]. No invertibility of $b_S$, trace, or diagonal integral is asserted.

proof.text: The hyperplane is Cartier over every base: its ideals are (t) and the unit ideal on the two standard charts. Their dual transitions identify its line with the specified O(1). This remains true after any base change.

proof.text: Use the supported Kummer boundary and compose with the constant unit. The free rank-one constant module source identifies module-derived Hom with abelian cohomology evaluated at one, so its Kummer realization determines c. This also identifies c with the existing normalized datum over Noetherian bases.

proof.text: The Cartier-preserving supported pullback square and unit mate identity give the hyperplane Chern pullback square. Take adjoints for the second direct-image component; the mate formula gives the first twisted-unit component. Biproduct extensionality gives the asserted square.

theorem exists_ordinaryFiniteP1KummerNaturality (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (_hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
          (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
        ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S
          ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
            hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) (c S hS) ∧
        (∀ [IsNoetherian S],
          c S hS = (projectiveLineTraceDatum N hN A hA S hS).chern)) ∧
      ∀ {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (f : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
          (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤))),
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A (X := S') (Y := S) f).map (ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) S hS (c S hS)) ≫
          ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A f
            ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (X := ProjectiveLine S') (Y := S')
            (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
            (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA
              (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA)
              (X := ProjectiveLine S') (Y := ProjectiveLine S)
              (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) f)
              ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
                hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom)).hom =
        ordinaryFiniteP1DecompositionSourceMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) f hS ≫
          ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingMap A N hA
            (projectiveLineTraceTransport N hN A hA) S' hS' (c S' hS')
